stylePrefix: Premium abstract 3D render, glossy dimensional shapes, soft studio lighting, dramatic depth of field, deep near-black charcoal background #050505, deep crimson red #7A0A15 accent lighting with subtle crimson glow, soft white highlights, high detail, cinematic centered composition. Clean minimal white sans-serif labels only where described, flawless legible text, no logos, no watermarks, no clutter.

prompts.sales: A glossy 3D sales pipeline rendered in dark space: a translucent glass funnel with six glowing spheres descending through it, each sphere brighter than the last, small floating 3D icons of a message bubble, a checkmark and a handshake above the funnel, tiny clean white label 'QUALIFY' near the top and 'WON' near the bottom edge. Crimson glow, deep near-black background.
prompts.support: A premium 3D customer support desk in dark space: a sleek floating counter with a glowing stack of chat bubbles rising from it, three small clean white labels along the bubbles reading 'QUESTION', 'INSTANT ANSWER', 'RESOLVED', and a glossy crimson checkmark badge on the final bubble. Warm inviting, crimson accent glow.
prompts.ops: A polished 3D automation engine in dark space: a glossy inbox cube at the center with two large glowing checkmark badges, mechanical gears orbiting it, small clean white labels reading 'AUTOMATION' on top and 'DONE' next to each checkmark. Smooth mechanical motion feel, crimson glow.
prompts.marketing: A dynamic 3D outreach hub in dark space: a central glossy rocket orbiting three floating platform cards styled like a photo feed, an X icon and a video reel, small clean white labels 'IG' and 'X' on the cards and a thin glowing banner below reading 'PERSONALIZE - SEND - SCALE'. Crimson accent glow, premium.
prompts.custom: A precise 3D integration kit in dark space: glossy puzzle pieces snapping together around a central glowing code chip, floating chips labeled '</>', 'API', 'DATA', 'DOCS' and 'LOGIC' orbiting in a clean arc. Engineered feel, deep crimson accent glow.
prompts.voice: A cinematic 3D call recovery scene in dark space: a glossy smartphone floating at the center with a glowing red missed-call burst on its left evolving into a glowing crimson answered call and a calendar checkmark on its right, small clean white labels 'MISSED', 'ANSWERED', 'BOOKED' below, and a small clock chip reading '2:00 PM'. Dramatic crimson glow.
